_about: Quests players' recordings show offered only after a hand-in. For each quest: `after`, the quests handed in within 5 seconds before a giver offered it (one of them unlocks it); `offeredAfter`, how many people were offered it right after each; `refusedWithout`, how many people the giver refused it to, in gossip windows, while they had none of `after` handed in (`established` of them with 3 days of history). Counts of people only. Built from the maintainer's recordings archive by the refusal sweep (#1299); tests/prereq-order.test.js plays every leveling path with `after` as an extra any-of prerequisite, so a guide that accepts such a quest before any of `after` is handed in fails.
